z-m-24-01.s.s3.ok.c1: a, b, c duk lambobi cikakku ne.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.fail.c1: Dole a, b, c su zama lambobi cikakku.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.fail.c2: a,b,c dole su kasance daga −9 zuwa 9.
z-m-24-01.title: Layi ɗaya a warwarewar ya share mafita
z-m-24-01.topic: Mafitocin da suke ɓacewa idan aka raba gefunan ma'auni biyu da furuci ɗaya
z-m-24-01.goal: Nemo layin warwarewar da mafita ta ɓace, faɗaɗa sharuɗɗan ma'aunai da hakan ke faruwa a cikinsu, sannan ka ƙirƙiri ma'aunai da kanka da suke rasa mafita, ka bayyana dalilin.
z-m-24-01.material: Jia ta warware x³ = 4x, sannan ta rubuta ‘mafita su ne 2 da −2, guda biyu’. Doyun ta duba warwarewar Jia, ta ce kawai amsar ta bambanta da tata ba tare da dalili ba. A wannan aiki, duk x lambobi na ainihi ne. (Ana karanta x³ da ‘x a kubik’, x² kuma da ‘x a murabba'i’.)
z-m-24-01.thinking.0: Nemo inda kuskuren yake a warwarewa
z-m-24-01.thinking.1: Tantance sharuɗɗan da sauya furuci ke canza saitin mafita a ƙarƙashinsu
z-m-24-01.thinking.2: Ƙirƙirar misalan ƙaryatawa (ma'aunai da suke rasa mafita) da kanka
z-m-24-01.prereq.0: H2 a wannan rukuni yana nufin rarrabawa bisa wahala da matakin tallafi, ba ajin da ake koyarwa a makaranta ba. Tsarin karatun da aka ɗauka: ka koyi warware ma'aunin murabba'i ta hanyar rarrabawa a sakandare, sannan ka gamu da rarraba furucin kubik a Lissafi na gama-gari.
z-m-24-01.prereq.1: Hanyar saka ƙima cikin ma'auni domin bincika ko gefunan biyu sun yi daidai
z-m-24-01.prereq.2: Dukkan x a wannan aiki lambobi na ainihi ne.
z-m-24-01.s.s1.prompt: Wannan warwarewar Jia ce. Zaɓi layin da ya sa warwarewar ba daidai ba, ko layin da kuskuren ya bayyana a fili.
z-m-24-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane layi, ka bincika ɗaya bayan ɗaya ‘shin ma'auni ne mai mafita iri ɗaya da na layin da ya gabata?’
z-m-24-01.s.s1.hint.1: Saka 0, 2, −2 a madadin x ɗaya bayan ɗaya, sannan ka bincika ko ma'aunin asali x³ = 4x yana aiki.
z-m-24-01.s.s1.line.0: Ka warware x³ = 4x. (x lambar ainihi ce)
z-m-24-01.s.s1.line.1: Raba gefunan biyu da x yana ba da x² = 4.
z-m-24-01.s.s1.line.4: Saboda haka mafitar ma'aunin nan su ne 2 da −2, guda biyu.
z-m-24-01.s.s1.explain: A layi na 2 mun raba da x, amma idan aka saka x=0 cikin ma'aunin asali, gefunan biyu 0 ne, don haka yana aiki. Ba a binciki x=0 dabam ba, saboda haka mafitar 0 ta ɓace, wannan kuma ya sa aka rubuta ‘guda biyu’ a layi na 5. Layuka na 3 da 4 sun warware ma'aunin daidai bayan rabawa. Ainihin mafita na ma'aunin asali su ne −2, 0, 2 guda uku.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.prompt: Dukkan ma'aunai da ke ƙasa ana warware su a lambobin ainihi. Wanne ne ba ya rasa ko ɗaya daga cikin mafitar ma'aunin asali idan aka raba gefunan biyu da furucin da aka nuna a baka ko bayanin, sannan aka warware ma'aunin da ya rage kawai?
z-m-24-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ga kowane ma'auni, ka bincika ko akwai ƙimar x da ke sa furucin da kake son rabawa da shi ya zama 0.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.hint.1: Saka ƙimomin da ka samu cikin gefunan biyu na ma'aunin asali, sannan ka duba ko akwai ma'auni da ba ya da irin wannan lambar ainihi sam.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.r.a: Wannan zaɓi bai bincika abin da zai faru da gefunan biyu ba idan aka saka ƙimar da ke sa x − 2=0 cikin ma'aunin asali.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.r.b: Ka manta cewa ƙimar da ke sa mai rabawa 0 ya zama tana iya zama mafita ta ma'aunin asali. Saka x=0.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.r.c: Wannan zaɓi ya yi aiki ta amfani da sharaɗin ko akwai lambar ainihi da za ta sa mai rabawa ya zama 0.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.r.d: Ko da akwai murabba'i, idan x − 1 ya zama 0, gefunan biyu duk 0 ne. Ka bincika ko wannan ƙimar mafita ce.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.explain: Idan gefunan biyu suna da fasalin f·g = f·h, ƙimar da ke sa f=0 koyaushe mafita ce. Don haka idan akwai lambar ainihi da ke sa f=0, dole ne a kula da ita dabam kafin rabawa. x²+3 aƙalla 3 ne ga kowace lambar ainihi, saboda haka ba ya zama 0; a c ba a rasa mafita (x=4) ta hanyar rabawa. Idan aka faɗaɗa kewayon zuwa lambobin hadaddun, dole ne a kuma yi la'akari da mafita na x²+3=0, saboda haka yanayin ya bambanta.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.prompt: Ka ƙirƙiri ma'aunai daban-daban guda 3 masu fasalin (x − a)(x − b) = c(x − a). a, b, c lambobi cikakku ne daga −9 zuwa 9, kuma c≠0. Ka sa hanyar da take raba gefunan biyu da x − a ta rasa mafita guda ɗaya; mafita da ta ɓace a zama maras kyau, mafitar b + c da aka samu bayan rabawa kuma ta zama tabbatacciya.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko ka zaɓi a ya zama maras kyau, sannan ka gwada sauya b da c domin b + c ya zama tabbatacce.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ka bincika abin da ke faruwa idan aka saka x=a a gefunan biyu na ma'aunin da ka ƙirƙira.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.ok.c2: Dukkan lambobi ukun suna tsakanin −9 da 9.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.ok.c4: Mafitar a da ta ɓace ba ta da kyau.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.fail.c4: a ba maras kyau ba ne.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.ok.c5: Mafitar b + c da aka samu bayan rabawa tabbatacciya ce.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.fail.c5: b + c ba tabbatacce ba ne.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.explain: Misali, idan a=−3, b=1, c=2, to (x+3)(x−1)=2(x+3). Idan aka raba da x+3, x=3 kawai ya rage, amma x=−3 ma yana sa gefunan biyu 0, saboda haka mafita ce. Matsar da komai gefe guda yana ba da (x+3)(x−3)=0, don haka mafita biyun su ne −3 da 3. Ana ɗaukar ma'aunai masu mafita a da mafita b+c da aka samu bayan rabawa iri ɗaya a matsayin ma'auni ɗaya; saboda haka idan ƙimomin biyun sun bambanta, ma'aunai daban-daban ne.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.prompt: Zaɓi ɗaya daga cikin ma'aunai da ka ƙirƙira, sannan ka rubuta a lambobi wace mafita ce take ɓacewa idan aka raba gefunan biyu da x−a, da dalilin.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.hint.0: Ka lissafta abin da kowane gefe yake zama idan aka saka x=a cikin ma'aunin da ka ƙirƙira.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.hint.1: Ka kwatanta gefe da gefe mafitar da aka samu ta furucin bayan rabawa da mafitar da aka samu bayan matsar da komai gefe guda.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.placeholder: Misali: Furucin da na ƙirƙira shi ne ...
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Ka bincika da lambobin misalinka cewa saka mafitar da za ta ɓace cikin ma'aunin asali yana sa gefunan biyu su yi daidai kuwa?
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana da kalmominka dalilin ‘ƙimar da ke sa mai rabawa ya zama 0’ kuwa?
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.selfAssess.2: Ka yi tunanin aƙalla hanya ɗaya ta nemo dukkan mafita ba tare da rabawa ba (misali, matsar da komai gefe guda a mayar da ninkar furuci).
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.model.0: Furucin da na ƙirƙira shi ne (x+3)(x−1)=2(x+3). Idan na raba da x+3, x=3 kawai ya rage; amma idan na saka x=−3, gefunan biyu 0 ne, saboda haka −3 ma mafita ce. Ita ce ƙimar da ke sa mai rabawa ya zama 0, don haka mafitar ta ɓace.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.model.1: A cikin (x+1)(x−4)=−1(x+1), rabawa da x+1 tana ba da x−4=−1 kawai, wato x=3. Amma idan x=−1, x+1=0 ne, gefunan biyu kuma sun yi daidai, saboda haka −1 ma mafita ce, kuma ta ɓace ne saboda rabawa da 0.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.modelNote.1: Yana da kyau an fara ambaton mafitar da aka samu bayan rabawa, sannan aka ambaci mafitar da ta ɓace.

z-m-24-02.title: Mafita nawa ne matsalar da ba ta fayyace kewayon ba take da su?
z-m-24-02.topic: Yawan mafita na ma'aunin kubik x³=1 da kewayon lambobi
z-m-24-02.goal: Ka tantance kewayon lambobin da mafita take ciki, ka riƙe ko ka gyara hukuncinka game da yawan mafita duk lokacin da sabon bayani ya zo, sannan ka tabbatar da amsa da ta danganta da kewayon da mafita da ka samo da kanka.
z-m-24-02.material: Akwai matsalar nemo mafitar ma'aunin x³=1. Ba a rubuta kewayon x a cikin matsalar ba. Minsu ya rubuta warwarewa ta kwatanta girma, Seoyun da ta gani kuma ta tambaya, ‘Ba sai mun fara yanke shawarar kewayon ba?’ Ana bayyana bayani ɗaya bayan ɗaya, don haka ka zaɓi hukuncinka a kowane mataki. (Ana karanta x³ da ‘x a kubik’.)
z-m-24-02.thinking.0: Bayyana kewayon (sharaɗi) da hujja take aiki a cikinsa
z-m-24-02.thinking.1: Gyara ko riƙe hukunci bisa sabon bayani
z-m-24-02.thinking.2: Rubuta amsa da ta danganta da kewayon
z-m-24-02.thinking.3: Nemo mafita da dama da kanka, sannan ka tabbatar da su
z-m-24-02.prereq.0: H2 a wannan rukuni yana nufin rarrabawa bisa wahala da matakin tallafi, ba ajin da ake koyarwa a makaranta ba. Tsarin karatun da aka ɗauka: ka riga ka koyi a Lissafi na gama-gari ma'anar lambobin hadaddun (naúrar ƙirƙirarre i, i²=−1) da ninkarsu, discriminant na ma'aunin murabba'i, da rarraba furucin kubik.
z-m-24-02.prereq.1: Sharaɗin da ke sa lambobin hadaddun biyu su yi daidai: sassan lamba na ainihi sun yi daidai da juna, sassan ƙirƙirarre kuma sun yi daidai da juna.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kowane lokaci, zaɓi hukunci sannan ka duba ko sabon bayani ya canza ko ya bar hukuncin yadda yake.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.hint.0: Duk lokacin da sabon bayani ya bayyana, sake karanta zaɓin da ka yi a baya, sannan ka rubuta a layi guda abin da ya canza.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kafin zaɓar amsa, da farko ka duba ‘wace kewayon lambobi’ zaɓin yake ɗauka.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Wannan matsala ce ta warware x³=1. Ba a rubuta kewayon x ba. Warwarewar Minsu: ‘x=1 mafita ce. Idan x>1, to x³>1; idan x<1 kuma, x³<1, saboda haka mafita guda ɗaya kawai ita ce x=1.’ (Ana karanta ‘>’ da ‘ya fi girma’ kuma ‘<’ da ‘ya fi ƙanƙanta’.)
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Yaya za ka tantance warwarewar Minsu?
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Idan x lambar ainihi ce, hujjar Minsu daidai ce (idan ta fi 1, x³>1; idan ta gaza 1, x³<1). Amma ba a rubuta kewayon ba, saboda haka ba mu sani ba ko yin tunani kan lambobin ainihi kawai ya isa.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ana iya kwatanta girman duk lambobi, saboda haka warwarewar Minsu daidai ce kuma mafita guda ɗaya ita ce 1
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ba ka yi la'akari da ko za a iya jera duk lambobi bisa girma da ƙanƙanta ba. Ka yi tunanin waɗanne lambobi ne za a iya kwatanta girman su.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Warwarewar daidai ce idan x lambar ainihi ce. Amma babu kewayon da aka bayyana, don haka ana buƙatar ƙarin bincike
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka lura da lambobin da warwarewar take ɗauka, kuma ka haɗa a hukuncinka cewa ba a bayyana kewayon ba.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Dole ma'aunin kubik ya kasance da mafita uku, saboda haka warwarewar da ta ce mafita guda ɗaya ba daidai ba ce
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ka tabbatar da yawan mafita daga darajar ma'auni kawai. Dole ne a bincika furucin da kewayon domin sanin yawan mafita daban-daban.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ka saka x=1 kawai, saboda haka ba za a iya sanin komai daga wannan warwarewar ba
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Warwarewar tana da wani sashe da ya yi la'akari da lokutan da suka fi 1 da waɗanda suka gaza 1 ma. Ka karanta abin da wannan sashen yake tabbatarwa.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Sabbin bayanai biyu sun bayyana. (1) x³−1=(x−1)(x²+x+1), kuma discriminant na ma'aunin murabba'i x²+x+1=0 shi ne 1−4=−3. (2) Bayanin da ke farkon littafin matsalar ya ce ‘a wannan darasi ana warware ma'aunai a lambobin hadaddun’, amma wannan matsala da kanta har yanzu ba ta fayyace kewayon ba.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Yanzu yaya za ka amsa tambayar ‘mafita daban-daban nawa ne?’
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Daga x−1=0 ana samun mafita ta ainihi 1, kuma x²+x+1=0 yana da discriminant mara kyau, saboda haka ba shi da mafita ta ainihi, yana da mafita ƙirƙirarru biyu daban-daban. A lambobin ainihi akwai mafita 1; a lambobin hadaddun akwai 3. Da yake ba a fayyace kewayon ba, amsa bisa kewayon, ko bayyana hasashen da aka ɗauka bisa bayanin darasin sannan a amsa 3, duka sun dace. Hukuncin Minsu cewa ‘a lambobin ainihi mafita guda ɗaya ce’ bai canza ba.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ba a fayyace kewayon a matsalar ba, don haka ka yi tunanin lambobin ainihi kawai ka amsa cewa mafita 1 ce
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Daidai ne a matsayin amsa ga kewayon lambobin ainihi, amma ba ka yi amfani da sabon bayani, lissafin discriminant da bayanin darasin, a hukuncinka ba.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Discriminant −3 ne, mara kyau ne, saboda haka wannan ma'auni ba shi da mafita a kowane kewayon lambobi
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Discriminant bayanin ne game da ɗaya daga cikin masu rabo, x²+x+1. Ka manta cewa akwai wani mai rabo kuma, x−1.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ka amsa ta rarraba kewayon: mafita 1 idan lambobin ainihi ne, mafita 3 idan hadaddun ne
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ka saka gaskiyar cewa ba a fayyace kewayon ba kai tsaye a cikin amsa. Wannan hukunci yana nuna cewa amsar ta danganta da sharuɗɗa.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ka bi bayanin darasin ka ɗauke shi a matsayin lambobin hadaddun, ka rubuta 3 tare da bayyana hasashen
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ka yi amfani da alamar bayanin darasin kuma ka bayyana hasashen. Wannan hukunci ya rubuta tushen amsa da iyakarta duka.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.info: A kira tushen ƙirƙirarre guda ɗaya ω = (−1 + √3 i)/2. (i naúrar ƙirƙirarre ce mai i²=−1, ana karanta furucin da ‘minti 1 da aka ƙara tushen 3i, bisa 2’.) Mun san ω tushen ma'aunin x²+x+1=0 ne. Muna son bincika kai tsaye ko wannan ω da gaske yana cika x³=1.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Waɗanne hanyoyin bincike ne ingantattu? (Wataƙila akwai hanyoyi da dama.)
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Hanyoyin biyu duka cikakkun bincike ne. a yana amfani da ω²+ω+1=0 kawai, c kuma yana nemo ω² kai tsaye sannan ya ninka. Ƙimar kusan (b) bincike ne kawai don gano kuskuren lissafi, ba tabbatarwa ba; d kuma yana ɗauka ƙarshe gaskiya ne tun farko. Da yake tushen ƙirƙirarre ma yana cika x³=1 haka, hukuncin farko cewa mafita 3 ne a lambobin hadaddun ya samu goyon baya.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Yi amfani da ω²=−ω−1 domin lissafta ω³=ω·ω²=−ω²−ω=1
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka zaɓi hanyar rage ω³ zuwa furuci mai daraja ɗaya a ω ta amfani da furucin da ka riga ka sani.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ka rubuta ω a matsayin −0.5 + 0.87i, ka yi ninkawa sau da dama, sannan ka ɗauka an tabbatar idan ya yi kusa da 1
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Lissafi da ƙimomin kusan yana taimakawa wajen bincike, amma ba ya tabbatar da cewa ainihin ƙimar 1 ce.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Nemo ω², ninka da ω domin bincika cewa (−1+√3 i)(−1−√3 i)/4=1
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ka zaɓi hanyar bincika ta ninkawa kai tsaye. Muhimmin abu shi ne yadda ɓangaren ƙirƙirarre yake ɓacewa.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Tun da ω tushen wani ma'auni ne, ka ɗauki ω³=1 a matsayin gaskiya tuni, ka yi amfani da shi yadda yake
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ka ɗauka ƙarshe da kake son bincika tuni gaskiya ne. Ma'aunin da ω tushensa ne shi ne x²+x+1=0, ba x³=1 ba.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.reflect: Idan da farko ka yi tunanin ‘mafita guda ɗaya ita ce 1’, wane bayani ne ya taƙaita hukuncin zuwa ‘daidai ne a lambobin ainihi’? Me ya sa ba za a iya amfani da hujjar kwatanta girma ga lambobin ƙirƙirarre ba?
z-m-24-02.s.s2.prompt: A ce lambar hadaddiya z=a+bi (a, b lambobi na ainihi ne) tana cika z³=1. Tun da (a+bi)³=(a³−3ab²)+(3a²b−b³)i, dole sashen ainihi a³−3ab² ya zama 1, sashen ƙirƙirarre 3a²b−b³ kuma ya zama 0. Shigar da mafita daban-daban guda 3 a matsayin (a, b). Ana iya zagaye lambobin marasa hankali zuwa guraben goma biyu, ana karɓar kuskuren 0.02 ko ƙasa da haka.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.hint.0: Ka bincika abin da x³−1 yake zama idan aka saka z=1, sannan ka nemo tushen furucin murabba'i da ya rage x²+x+1.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.hint.1: Saka sashen ainihi na tushen da ka samo a cikin a, lambar da ke gaban i kuma a cikin b; ka lissafta ko furucin biyun suna kusa da 1 da 0, bi da bi.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Sashen ainihi ya yi daidai da 1 (kuskuren bai wuce 0.02 ba).
z-m-24-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Sashen ainihi a³−3ab² na (a+bi)³ ba 1 ba ne.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Sashen ƙirƙirarre ya yi daidai da 0 (kuskuren bai wuce 0.02 ba).
z-m-24-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Sashen ƙirƙirarre 3a²b−b³ na (a+bi)³ ba 0 ba ne.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.explain: Mafita su ne uku: z=1, z=(−1+√3 i)/2, z=(−1−√3 i)/2. A matsayin adadin goma sun kusan zama (1, 0), (−0.5, 0.87), (−0.5, −0.87). Mafita ɗaya da aka rubuta da lambobi daban bayan digo ba a ƙirga ta a matsayin wata mafita ba. Mafita guda ɗaya da sashen ƙirƙirarrenta 0 shi ne 1, kuma kwatanta girma kawai ba zai nemo sauran mafita biyun ba.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa hujjar Minsu ‘idan ya fi 1, x³>1, idan ya gaza 1, x³<1’ ba za ta nemo tushen ƙirƙirarre ba, sannan ka faɗi yawan mafita daban-daban a kewayon lambobin ainihi da na lambobin hadaddun.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Ka nuna lambobin da ake ɗauka a duk inda aka yi amfani da ‘x>1’ ko ‘x<1’ a hujjar Minsu.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Ka ware kewayon lambobin ainihi da na lambobin hadaddun, sannan ka ƙidaya mafita da ka samo a baya ga kowanne.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka bayyana da kalmominka cewa hujjar Minsu ta dogara da ‘waɗanne lambobi ne za a iya kwatanta girmansu’ kuwa?
z-m-24-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka rubuta yawan mafita a kewayon lambobin ainihi da kuma yawan mafita a kewayon lambobin hadaddun duka kuwa?
z-m-24-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ka yi tunanin tushen ƙirƙirarre ta danganta su da ƙimomin da ka samo a sama (sashen ainihi −0.5 da sauransu) kuwa?
z-m-24-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Warwarewar Minsu daidai ce ne kawai idan x lambar ainihi ce. Ana iya kwatanta girma tsakanin lambobin ainihi kawai; ba za a iya jera lambobin ƙirƙirarre bisa girma ba, don haka ba za a iya nemo tushen ƙirƙirarre da wannan hanyar ba. A kewayon lambobin ainihi akwai mafita 1, a kewayon lambobin hadaddun kuma akwai 3.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.because.model.1: A kewayon lambobin hadaddun, ba za a iya amfani da hujjar Minsu ba. Lambobin ƙirƙirarre ba su da mafi girma ko ƙanƙanta, saboda haka ba za a iya yin hujja da alamomin rashin daidaito ba. Idan lambobin ainihi ne, mafita guda ɗaya (1) ce; idan hadaddun ne, mafita uku ne: 1 da tushen ƙirƙirarre biyu.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: An bayyana sharaɗin kwatanta girma da furucin ‘ba za a iya yin hujja da alamomin rashin daidaito ba.’
